subject: Welcome, Overseer
body: You have been dropped into the region with three volunteers and a cache of supplies. Establish a foothold, grow it, and earn it full city status. Your orders and milestones are on this tablet; open it any time with Tab.

subject: Not enough housing
body: People are waiting at the gate and every bed is taken. Build a bunkhouse or upgrade one with bunk beds.

subject: Not enough food
body: The stores cannot feed more mouths. Build more farms and post farmers before taking anyone else in.
